title: Final Answer Inside
description: Essential Criteria: The expression for the electric potential inside the sphere must be correctly stated.

title: Final Answer Outside
description: Essential Criteria: The expression for the electric potential outside the sphere must be correctly stated.

title: Boundary Condition
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly apply the boundary condition at the surface of the sphere.

title: Use of Legendre Polynomials
description: Important Criteria: The student should recognize the use of Legendre polynomials in the potential expansion.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid sign mistakes in the potential expressions.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should check that the units are consistent throughout the solution.

title: Symmetry Consideration
description: Optional Criteria: The student should acknowledge the symmetry of the problem in their reasoning.
